readme:
High-End Blockchain Institutional Platform. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Luxury meets blockchain. Premium dark mode for institutional crypto investors. Sophisticated elegance with cutting-edge technology visualization.

**Blend:** Crypto Luxury 70% + Dark Premium 30%  
**Temperature:** 3/10 (cool) · **Formality:** 8/10 · **Tags:** tech, premium  
**Perfect for:** Crypto Exchanges, Blockchain Startups, Web3 Projects

## Content fundamentals

- Write for members and staff of the organization: direct, formal and composed.
- Headings name the thing plainly: “Institutional Portfolio Dashboard”, “Premium Insights”, “DeFi Yield Optimization”, “Institutional Custody”.
- Buttons are short verb phrases in Title Case: “🔔”, “Connect Wallet”, “View All”, “⚙️”.
- Navigation uses single nouns: “Portfolio”, “Markets”, “Analytics”, “Insights”.
- The reference page uses emoji as inline glyphs (🔔 💎 📊 🎯 🛡 ⚡); keep them functional, never decorative.

## Color

- Set the page on `page-bg` with body text in `page-text`. The theme is dark.
- Identity colours: `color-electric-purple`, `color-gold`. Lead with the first; use the rest for accents and emphasis.
- Status colours (`color-success`, `color-success-glow`) always travel with a word or icon; never signal state by hue alone.
- Each token's note says where the reference page uses it and, for text colours, its contrast on `page-bg`. Keep body text at 4.5:1 or better.

### Palette rationale

- ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## Typography

- `display` — "Space Grotesk", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

Faces are hosted on Google Fonts (Space Grotesk); load them with:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap">
```

- Set titles in `display`, sections in `heading-2` and running text in `body`.
- Uppercase is reserved for small labels (`label`), always with the letter-spacing given.

### Type rationale

- ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## Spacing, shape and elevation

- Spacing steps: `space-micro` 0.5rem, `space-small` 1rem, `space-medium` 1.5rem, `space-large` 2.5rem, `space-xl` 4rem. Pad cards and sections from these steps only.
- Corners: `radius-small` 8px, `radius-medium` 12px, `radius-large` 16px, `radius-xl` 24px.
- Elevation: `shadow-card`, `shadow-glow-purple`, `shadow-glow-gold`, `shadow-glow-hover`, lowest first for resting cards, higher for hover and overlays.

- ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## States and motion

- ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Timing values: `--transition-smooth` 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), `--transition-glow` 200ms ease-in-out, `--transition-gradient` 400ms ease.

- Honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: drop lifts and transitions to instant state changes.

## Iconography

- Inline SVG line icons on a 24×24 viewBox, 2px stroke, drawn in `currentColor` so they take the text colour around them.
- No logo ships with this style: set the organization name in the `display` style.

## Accessibility

- `page-text` on `page-bg` measures 13.2:1.
- Every interactive element shows a visible focus state at 3:1 or better against its surface.

From the style's design notes (ratios checked against the tokens; a **bold** measurement replaces a claim that does not hold):

- ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## Component inventory

The reference page composes these patterns from the tokens above:

- ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## Further guidance

### Primary Palette

- Deep Black (#0c0c0c)     → Foundation, premium sophistication
- Electric Purple (#8b5cf6) → Innovation, blockchain technology
- Gold (#fbbf24)           → Wealth, premium value, institutional trust
- Platinum Gray (#a1a1aa)  → Refinement, secondary information

### Supporting Palette

- Dark Surface (#171717)   → Elevated cards, glass layers
- Purple Glow (#8b5cf680)  → Accent borders, hover states
- Gold Accent (#fbbf2440)  → Premium highlights, success states
- Slate Border (#27272a)   → Subtle divisions, container edges

### Gradient System

- Purple-to-Violet: Premium feature highlights, CTAs
- Gold-to-Amber: Success metrics, positive growth
- Platinum-to-Gray: Neutral backgrounds, secondary cards

### Font Family

- Space Grotesk (Modern Geometric)
- Display: 700 weight, 2.5rem-3.5rem, -0.02em tracking
- Headline: 600 weight, 1.5rem-2rem, -0.01em tracking
- Body: 400 weight, 1rem, 0em tracking
- Caption: 300 weight, 0.875rem, 0.01em tracking

### Formality Level

- (High Premium)
- Institutional-grade language and tone
- Professional metric presentation
- Sophisticated visual hierarchy

### Temperature

- (Cool Futuristic)
- Technology-forward aesthetic
- Clean, precise layouts
- Minimal warm tones, maximum precision

- SPACING SYSTEM (Premium Generous):
- ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
- Micro: 0.5rem (8px)    → Tight inline spacing
- Small: 1rem (16px)     → Component padding
- Medium: 1.5rem (24px)  → Section spacing
- Large: 2.5rem (40px)   → Premium card gaps
- XL: 4rem (64px)        → Major section divisions

### Glass Morphism Cards

- backdrop-filter: blur(20px)
- background: rgba(23, 23, 23, 0.6)
- border: 1px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.3)
- border-radius: 16px
- box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)

### Gradient Borders

- Electric purple to violet linear gradients
- Gold accent overlays on premium elements
- 2px width for primary importance
- Animated glow on hover (0-8px purple shadow)
